field.desc: [Internal] Moves a project milestone to another project, can be called to undo a prior move.
field.name: projectMilestoneMove

invocation.doc: mutation ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeamUpdateProjectMilestoneMove($id: String!, $input: ProjectMilestoneMoveInput!) { projectMilestoneMove(id: $id, input: $input) { previousProjectTeamIds { ...ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeamFields } success } } fragment ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeamFields on ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeams { projectId teamIds }

ProjectMilestoneMoveInput.desc: [Internal] Input for moving a project milestone to another project.

addIssueTeamToProject.desc: Whether to add each milestone issue's team to the project. This is needed when there is a mismatch between a project's teams and the milestone's issues' teams. Either this or newIssueTeamId is required in that situation to resolve constraints.
addIssueTeamToProject.name: addIssueTeamToProject

newIssueTeamId.desc: The team id to move the attached issues to. This is needed when there is a mismatch between a project's teams and the milestone's issues' teams. Either this or addIssueTeamToProject is required in that situation to resolve constraints.
newIssueTeamId.name: newIssueTeamId

projectId.desc: The identifier of the project to move the milestone to.
projectId.name: projectId

undoIssueTeamIds.desc: A list of issue id to team ids, used for undoing a previous milestone move where the specified issues were moved from the specified teams.
undoIssueTeamIds.name: undoIssueTeamIds

undoProjectTeamIds.desc: A mapping of project id to a previous set of team ids, used for undoing a previous milestone move where the specified teams were added to the project.
undoProjectTeamIds.name: undoProjectTeamIds

ProjectMilestoneMoveInput.name: ProjectMilestoneMoveInput

ProjectMilestoneMoveIssueToTeamInput.desc: [Internal] Used for ProjectMilestoneMoveInput to describe a mapping between an issue and its team.

issueId.desc: The issue id in this relationship, you can use * as wildcard if all issues are being moved to the same team
issueId.name: issueId

teamId.desc: The team id in this relationship
teamId.name: teamId

ProjectMilestoneMoveIssueToTeamInput.name: ProjectMilestoneMoveIssueToTeamInput

ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeamsInput.desc: [Internal] Used for ProjectMilestoneMoveInput to describe a snapshot of a project and its team ids

teamIds.desc: The team ids for the project
teamIds.name: teamIds

ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeamsInput.name: ProjectMilestoneMoveProjectTeamsInput

String.desc: The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.
String.name: String
